name: azwah-platform
description: Azwah family resilience platform. Repository-level convenience scripts only; every app has its own package.json.

scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && dotnet run --project FamilyResilience.Api -- db migrate
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && dotnet run --project FamilyResilience.Api -- db seed
scripts.db:reset: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres
scripts.demo:db: cd backend && dotnet run --project FamilyResilience.Api -- db demo
scripts.demo:reset: cd backend && dotnet run --project FamilyResilience.Api -- db demo --reset
